mapper.select: SELECT auction_window_id, last_decision_id, last_decision_version, last_stream_id FROM promotion_projection_checkpoint WHERE auction_window_id = #{auctionWindowId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_projection_checkpoint ( auction_window_id, last_decision_id, last_decision_version, last_stream_id, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{auctionWindowId}, #{lastDecisionId}, #{lastDecisionVersion}, #{lastStreamId}, NOW(3) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_decision_id = VALUES(last_decision_id), last_decision_version = VALUES(last_decision_version), last_stream_id = VALUES(last_stream_id), updated_at = NOW(3)
